exercises.prompt: K1：将所给正弦型图像写成 $y=a\sin[b(x-c)]+d$，其中 $a>0,b>0$，并取最小的 $|c|$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 根据该函数形式选基准相位，得 $c=- \frac{3 \pi}{2}$。所有等价相移相差 $4\pi$，此值的绝对值最小。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入最大点 $x=-\pi/2$ 得1，代入最小点 $x=3\pi/2$ 得-5，核对方程 $y=3\sin[\tfrac12(x-(- \frac{3 \pi}{2}))]-2$。

en.prompt: K1. Write an equation $y=a\sin[b(x-c)]+d$ for the given sinusoidal graph, with $a>0,b>0$ and the smallest possible $|c|$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The extrema 1 and -5 give $a=(1-(-5))/2=3$ and $d=(1+(-5))/2=-2$. Adjacent maxima $-\pi/2,7\pi/2$ are $4\pi$ apart, so $b=1/2$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Match the standard phase for the requested form to obtain $c=- \frac{3 \pi}{2}$. Equivalent shifts differ by $4\pi$, and this representative has the smallest magnitude.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitution gives 1 at the maximum $x=-\pi/2$ and -5 at the minimum $x=3\pi/2$, verifying $y=3\sin[\tfrac12(x-(- \frac{3 \pi}{2}))]-2$.

steps.title: 计算与推导

en.prompt: K5. Use the given rounded value $\sin137^\circ=0.682$ to evaluate $\sin^{-1}(0.682)$ in degrees.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\sin137^\circ=\sin43^\circ$; arcsine selects $[-90^\circ,90^\circ]$, giving $43^\circ$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The given trigonometric value is rounded, so interpret the resulting angle as an approximation based on that source relationship.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 用反正弦奇性，由 $\sin^{-1}(0.682)\approx43^\circ$ 得 $-43^\circ$。

steps.title: 计算与推导

en.prompt: K6. Use the given rounded value $\sin137^\circ=0.682$ to evaluate $\sin^{-1}(-0.682)$ in degrees.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Arcsine is odd; since $\sin^{-1}(0.682)\approx43^\circ$, the negative input gives $-43^\circ$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 余弦为偶函数，$\cos(-68^\circ)=\cos68^\circ$；68度在 $[0^\circ,180^\circ]$ 内。

en.prompt: K7. Use the given rounded value $\cos(-68^\circ)=0.3746$ to evaluate $\cos^{-1}(0.3746)$ in degrees.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Cosine is even: $\cos(-68^\circ)=\cos68^\circ$; 68 degrees lies in $[0^\circ,180^\circ]$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 利用 $\cos(180^\circ-68^\circ)=-\cos68^\circ$，取主值112度。
